commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+11' The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+10' Antoine Semenyo goes off the pitch and Veljko Milosavljevic (Bournemouth) comes on.
90+7' The attendance for today's match is 11212.

90+5' 3 - 2 What a goal! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes into the bottom right corner and behind the goalkeeper.

90+4' David Brooks (Bournemouth) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
89' 8:15 – the total goal attempt statistics.
87' Here's the change. Alejandro Jimenez leaves the pitch and Amine Adli (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
87' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bafode Diakite (Bournemouth) replacing Marcus Tavernier.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Archie Gray is coming onto the pitch as Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' A header by Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) from very close range goes towards the top right corner, but doesn't get past Djordje Petrovic, who makes a brilliant save.
83' Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' A big rebound finds it way to Wilson Odobert (Tottenham), whose attempted long-range shot is almost immediately blocked by one of the opposition players.
78' 2 - 2 GOAL! Great reaction there from Joao Palhinha (Tottenham), who acrobatically contorts his body to score inside the box from a rebound. It’s 2:2.
78' Tottenham win a corner.
77' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
75' The referee gives a yellow card to Micky van de Ven (Tottenham).
75' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Darren England changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
74' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Tottenham as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

73' Darren England blows his whistle and signals a foul after James Hill (Bournemouth) brought his opponent down. Tottenham are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.

71' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Enes Unal (Bournemouth) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
70' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Richarlison (Tottenham) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the right post!
70' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Joao Palhinha (Tottenham). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
69' Now Tottenham have a corner.
67' The game has come to an end for Randal Kolo Muani. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Richarlison (Tottenham).
65' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
64' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. David Brooks (Bournemouth) replaces Eli Junior Kroupi.
64' Substitution. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) in, Evanilson out.
63' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Tottenham is cautioned for aggressive play. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bournemouth.
61' This is a yellow card! Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
60' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
59' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
57' Lucas Bergvall is substituted due to injury. Thomas Frank gives a chance to Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).
55' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
51' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
49' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
45+2' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) tackles a bit over-zealously and Darren England blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Tottenham, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
43' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
36' 2 - 1 Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
35' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.

32' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
28' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) launches a cross from the corner, but Djordje Petrovic is alert to thwart the effort.
25' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth). A free kick has been awarded to Tottenham.
22' 1 - 1 Evanilson (Bournemouth) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the left post.
22' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
22' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.

21' Evanilson (Bournemouth) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

20' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
20' Tottenham get a corner.

19' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
17' Corner kick. Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
16' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
16' The Tottenham players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
12' Evanilson (Bournemouth) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

11' Good team movement sets up Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
7' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call.
5' 0 - 1 Mathys Tel (Tottenham) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.

5' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic was ready and made a save.
2' Bournemouth work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' Evanilson (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Tottenham will take the kick-off.
